Import models and API keys from a JSON file

The file must be a JSON array (or an object containing a "models" array). Each model needs at least modelName and either provider or baseUrl. apiKey is optional. If provider is openai, anthropic or gemini, baseUrl can be omitted; for other services (e.g. OpenRouter, Groq) baseUrl is required. Duplicates are detected within the file and against existing models. The active model is never changed.

Gemini Live voice, Hands-free, Owner Voice
Gemini Live is an additional voice mode. The standard speech recognition + text-to-speech flow stays the default and is used automatically if Gemini Live cannot start or fails.
Live audio is streamed to Google\'s Gemini service while a session is active.
Keep the live conversation open longer and keep the CPU awake while the screen is off

Only your voice is sent to Gemini Live. Uses offline speech models stored on this device. It reduces, but does not eliminate, the chance that someone else is accepted — do not rely on it as a security lock.
